summary: Kiro Students gives eligible students at participating universities 1,000 credits per month for one year at no cost, including premium models and Kiro Web. Amazon's September 2026 announcement expands the program to 132 universities across 18 countries (a 12x scale-up from the 11-university pilot). Applicants must be at least 18, use a participating university email, and verify enrollment through SheerID. No credit card is required. Credits do not roll over, add-ons are unavailable, and the account downgrades to Kiro Free after the benefit period. Kiro enables content collection for service improvement by default for Free Tier and individual users; this content may be used for model training, and users can opt out.
claim_steps: Open Kiro Students and sign up or log in with Google, GitHub, or AWS Builder ID using an eligible university-affiliated email.
Open the account page and select the “You are eligible for Kiro Students” verification banner.
Verify student status through SheerID; proof such as a student ID or enrollment letter may be requested.
After approval, use 1,000 credits per month for 12 months. Unused credits do not roll over.
To opt out of content use, open Settings → User → Application → Telemetry and Content, then disable Content Collection for Service Improvement.
